final:
isqrt(n: int) -> int =
  pre n >= 0
  post out >= 0 and out * out <= n and n // (out + 1) < out + 1
  ex isqrt(0) == 0
  ex isqrt(8) == 2
  ex isqrt(9) == 3
  var lo = 0
  var hi = 3037000500
  while hi - lo > 1
    let mid = lo + (hi - lo) // 2
    if mid <= n // mid
      lo = mid
    else
      hi = mid
  lo

test_isqrt() =
  assert isqrt(0) == 0
  assert isqrt(1) == 1
  assert isqrt(15) == 3
  assert isqrt(16) == 4
  assert isqrt(9223372036854775807) == 3037000499
